bottlenecks_identified: Timing attribution is still too coarse. Milestone durations are inferred from `[conductor]` commit gaps, and frequent `Checkpoint: preserve uncommitted work from interrupted run` commits blur actual experiment runtime versus coding, retries, idle gaps, and documentation work.

Paired live GPU work was under-utilized. Exp 219, Exp 220, and Exp 221 were completed before Exp 225 introduced `DualGPURunner`, and the checked-in later live artifacts do not record default parallel execution, so the 2x RTX 3090 host was not used consistently.

The validation loop is a material bottleneck. Most experiments reran targeted coverage, `pytest tests/python -q`, `scripts/check_spec_coverage.py`, E2E or integration checks, and `validate-reconciliation.sh`; the full Python suite alone was roughly 77 to 98 seconds per run in conductor logs.

Manual doc reconciliation remained high-frequency and error-prone. Git history shows a dedicated `Update docs for Exp ...` commit after nearly every experiment plus extra `Update docs before planning` sync passes, and stale provenance text triggered additional 2026-04-13 docs repair work.

Retry and queue churn cost time. The conductor log shows repeated self-heal passes for pre-existing test failures, multiple failed attempts on Exp 233, Exp 236, Exp 237, and Exp 238, and repeated `Deliverable already exists in repo` executions that should have been pruned earlier.

Operational telemetry is incomplete. `ops/metrics.md` still records `Tokens (est)` as `TBD` because `scripts/session-metrics.py` is missing, and the live benchmark artifacts do not capture per-phase timings or parallel-execution metadata.
improvements_suggested: Record phase-level timings in the conductor and in experiment artifacts: pre-flight, agent implementation, live run, post-flight validation, doc reconciliation, and retry or resume time.

Make paired Qwen and Gemma benchmarks default to dual-GPU warm execution on 2-GPU hosts: `--parallel` by default, `ModelServer` warm loads, and artifact fields for `parallel_requested`, `parallel_enabled`, `parallel_execution_mode`, and per-GPU occupancy.

Replace always-on full-suite pre-flight validation with a tiered gate: fast changed-file smoke checks for most tasks, full Python or spec or E2E sweeps for framework changes, milestone boundaries, and externally visible API changes.

Generate `ops/changelog.md`, `ops/status.md`, `_bmad/traceability.md`, and provenance-count updates from structured experiment metadata so reconciliation becomes one automated step instead of a second manual commit after every experiment.

Prune duplicate roadmap tasks before launch and auto-skip tasks whose deliverables already exist and validate cleanly. Keep checkpoint-resume state out of milestone timing totals so interrupted runs do not look like productive wall time.

Run `gpu_monitor` automatically before and after long live jobs and log detected processes, but keep zombie reaping conservative. The current snapshot shows harmless 2MB idle CUDA contexts, not the greater-than-1GB zombie class the monitor is designed to catch.
Restore the missing session-metrics extraction script or replace it so milestone retrospectives can separate token and cost burn from experiment and runtime burn.
